name: Bruce Cavers
headline: Senior Director, Professional Services at NetSuite GBU (Oracle)
about:
Senior Consulting and Solution Leader, focused on guiding Customers in their adoption of cloud solutions.

25 years of experience delivering ERP/CRM/Ecommerce Software implementations, with a focus on Enterprise Architecture, Customization Development, and Integrations. Bruce excels as a Pre-Sales and Architecture Lead, and had been responsible for selling and delivering implementations for many of NetSuite’s most strategic Customers over the past 18 years. He also led incredible growth in NetSuite’s Technical Services team (over 10x), establishing multiple onshore and offshore delivery teams.
